mentions.name: Spreadsheet Data Platform
mentions.description: A spreadsheet platform in which every component is a plugin that users can supply or write themselves: custom formula functions, custom cell value formatting, custom templates and scripts that generate spreadsheets, and context-executing scripts or plugins that shorten common snippets. It includes a terminal where everything in the spreadsheet is a file — cells can be read and written as paths like /cell/A1.txt or /spreadsheet/123/cell/A1, with environment values such as SPREADSHEET_ID.
mentions.problem: Conventional spreadsheets limit formula functions, value formatting, templates, and icon-based interaction; this platform lets users replace each of these with their own plugins and scripts.
mentions.source_excerpt: Im working on what i call a spreadsheet data platform. It looks like a spreadsheet but all the components are plugins which means the user can provide (even write their own).
mentions.author: MiroslavPokorny
